{{Top|leg}}
'''Project Ignition''' was the codename for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] scientific project with the aim of developing an [[M1-4X's power core|alien power core]] into a usable technology. Under [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Boab Deduun]], the project produced the [[M1-4X]] Advanced War Droid.
